summary: Dokuwiki is a PHP-based wiki engine that stores all content directly in plain text files rather than a relational database. Its straightforward syntax allows you to read and edit your documentation files even outside the application interface.
goodFor: It is well-suited for users seeking a lightweight documentation system that avoids database management and keeps data portable.
watchOut: File-based storage can experience performance bottlenecks or concurrency issues at very large scales compared to database-backed alternatives.
deployNotes: You will typically need a standard web server like Nginx or Apache with PHP support, alongside persistent storage for the flat files.
